skills.name: app-publishing
skills.description: Publish a tested Robium application as a coherent project page, article, and media set.

skills.name: architect
skills.description: Start robotics apps or demos from compatible examples for mapping/navigation, robot assistants, or pretrained manipulation. Choose a stack if none fits; not existing-app maintenance.

skills.name: cloud-run
skills.description: Deploy and debug headless robotics containers on Google Cloud Run.

skills.name: data
skills.description: Choose and structure training data for robot-learning projects.

skills.name: environments
skills.description: Set up reproducible robotics environments with uv, Docker, or GPU hosts.

skills.name: foxglove
skills.description: Visualize live or recorded ROS robot data remotely with Foxglove or Lichtblick.

skills.name: gazebo
skills.description: Build and debug modern Gazebo simulations and their ROS 2 boundary.

skills.name: gemini-robotics
skills.description: Integrate and debug Gemini Robotics ER perception, function calls, and guarded execution. For a first natural-language robot assistant demo, start with architect's reference-app selection.

skills.name: huggingface
skills.description: Inspect and manage robotics datasets, models, Jobs, and Spaces on Hugging Face.

skills.name: integration
skills.description: Wire robotics modules with ROS 2 interfaces, Docker Compose, or non-ROS transports.

skills.name: isaac-lab
skills.description: Train, imitate, evaluate, and deploy robot policies with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.

skills.name: isaac-sim
skills.description: Build GPU-accelerated robot simulations and synthetic-data pipelines with NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

skills.name: learning-loop
skills.description: Run Robium's learning cycle when asked or when its session-start reminder is approved: consolidate captured signals, absorb ready guidance, refine skills, and inspect learning status.

skills.name: lerobot
skills.description: Build and debug LeRobot datasets, training, and policy evaluation. For a first pretrained robot-arm demo, start with architect's reference-app selection.

skills.name: live-demo
skills.description: Add temporary, isolated hosted sessions to a tested robotics application.

skills.name: mining
skills.description: Mine, compare, or re-crawl approved external robotics repositories into local evidence-cited Robium observations for later skill absorption.

skills.name: mujoco
skills.description: Build and debug lightweight robot manipulation simulations with MuJoCo.

skills.name: navigation
skills.description: Configure, extend, and debug Nav2 in an existing robot app; explain navigation concepts. New mapping/localization/navigation demos start with architect.

skills.name: rerun
skills.description: Visualize robot and machine-learning data with Rerun.

skills.name: ros2
skills.description: Build and debug robot software whose runtime interfaces use ROS 2.

skills.name: runpod
skills.description: Provision, diagnose, and clean up paid RunPod compute for robotics workloads.

skills.name: rviz2
skills.description: Inspect and debug live ROS 2 robot state with RViz2.

skills.name: simulation
skills.description: Choose between Gazebo, Isaac Sim, and MuJoCo and define what the simulation must prove.

skills.name: skill-author
skills.description: Author and structure practical Robium skills without unnecessary context or ceremony.

skills.name: test-assets
skills.description: Choose and manage reproducible worlds, models, datasets, and recordings for robotics tests.

skills.name: testing
skills.description: Choose proportional evidence for robotics software before claiming it works.

skills.name: visualization
skills.description: Choose between RViz2, Foxglove, Lichtblick, and Rerun to inspect robot behavior.
